title: Diffusion-based Denoising Beats Vanilla Score Matching in Parameter Estimation: A Theoretical Explanation
abstract: arXiv:2605.22950v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Score matching is an alternative to maximum likelihood estimation when the normalizing constant is unknown or too costly to evaluate. However, vanilla score matching has shown to be inefficient relative to maximum likelihood estimation for multimodal distributions with well-separated modes, which are commonly encountered in practical applications. We compare a novel diffusion-based denoising score matching estimator (DDSME) to the vanilla score matching estimator (SME) in this scenario. In particular, we prove statistical guarantees for both estimators, showing that the error bound for the vanilla SME worsens when the separation between the modes increases, which can be avoided in case of the DDSME with suitable hyperparameter tuning. This provides a novel theoretical explanation for the superior behavior of diffusion-based score matching over the vanilla version. We support our theoretical findings by numerical experiments.

translated_title: 基于扩散的去噪在参数估计中优于普通分数匹配：一个理论解释
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.22950v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：当归一化常数未知或评估成本过高时，分数匹配是最大似然估计的替代方法。然而，对于实际应用中常见的具有良好分离模式的多峰分布，普通分数匹配相对于最大似然估计已被证明效率较低。我们在此场景下比较了一种新颖的基于扩散的去噪分数匹配估计器（DDSME）与普通分数匹配估计器（SME）。特别地，我们为两种估计器证明了统计保证，表明当模式间分离度增加时，普通SME的误差界会恶化，而通过适当的超参数调整，DDSME可以避免这种情况。这为基于扩散的分数匹配优于普通版本提供了新颖的理论解释。我们通过数值实验支持了我们的理论发现。
tldr: 本文首次从理论上证明，对于多峰分布，基于扩散的去噪分数匹配估计器（DDSME）通过避免模式分离导致的误差恶化，优于普通分数匹配估计器，从而解释了其优越性。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first theoretical proof that diffusion-based denoising score matching estimator (DDSME) outperforms vanilla score matching estimator (SME) for multimodal distributions by avoiding error degradation due to mode separation, explaining its superiority.
